comparator.name: Geneeskunde
comparator.sourceNotes: The 180 EC Epicurus bachelor has no separate formal route. Four recurring organ-system themes combine with academic and professional strands. The official study programme sets credits and confirms the placement, restricted 18 EC elective space, medical thesis and final practice block. The dated assessment programme corroborates the structure. UvA student guidance documents progression and the methodology requirement before the thesis.

Clinical epidemiology, statistics and evidence-based medicine.

Patient-centred study of arrhythmia, coagulation disorders, pulmonary embolism and renal failure.

core: Human biology, anatomy, physiology, disease mechanisms and treatment science
Patient-centred clinical care, diagnostic reasoning and professional medical skills
Scientific foundations, methods, data and evidence in medicine
Development, brain function, cognition and psychological experience of illness
Ethical and social questions in inclusive healthcare
adjacent: Biomedical disease mechanisms and health research
Health behaviour, cognitive function and patients social experience
questions: How do biological mechanisms and evidence inform understanding of disease?
How do cognition, behaviour and social circumstances shape illness experience?
How can healthcare reduce environmental burdens?

candidates.label: Health behaviour, cognition and patient experience in social context
Environmental sustainability of healthcare
candidates.rationale: The healthcare sustainability interest is supported, but the current health and environmental courses do not form a sustained curriculum in how care services use resources and reduce environmental impacts.

alternatives.label: Biomedical disease mechanisms, health & research
alternatives.labelReason: Life, health, cognition and psychology courses form the substantive curriculum, supported by research methods, data analysis, ethics and mandatory PPD. The title describes biomedical and psychological study of health and disease without implying Medicine or clinical competence.
alternatives.concept: Study how the human body works and how disease affects it. Combine anatomy, physiology, molecular biology, immunity and pharmacology with epidemiology and research methods.
progression: Biomedical and brain/behaviour gateways precede all dependent courses. Cell biology, physiology, biochemistry and anatomy precede advanced pathology and pharmacology where feasible. Research Methods & Statistics precedes experimental statistics and the meta-analysis seminar. Formal prerequisites and exact planned availability pass. Data handling occurs before final-year evidence synthesis. Psychopathology is placed before Psychodiagnostics & Psychotherapies as a useful advisory progression.

alternatives.label: Health, cognition, behaviour & social experience
alternatives.labelReason: Seventeen biomedical, cognition and psychology courses form the main curriculum. Sociology, qualitative inquiry, ethics, methods and public persuasion connect this substantial core to illness experience and social conditions. Inclusion is an application supported by these tools rather than a claim that all courses teach healthcare inclusion.
alternatives.concept: Study how brain function, development, behaviour and social conditions shape health and illness. Combine health psychology with biological foundations, qualitative research and studies of health communication.
alternatives.distinctness: 6 courses and 45 EC differ in each direction. This option emphasises cognition, behaviour and social inquiry, while the first develops laboratory and organ-system disease mechanisms.
progression: Cell biology and brain and behaviour foundations precede anatomy, neurobiology, language and introductory research. Social psychology precedes advanced health psychology and psychological assessment. Perception and Action provides a later neuroscience application. Current offerings and prerequisites pass.

selection.assessment: Two evidence-supported options share biomedical and research foundations and differ in purpose and by at least 30 EC. The third direction would combine healthcare science and environmental courses without enough healthcare-specific integration. This coherence finding is separate from course planning.

notes.text: UvA combines biomedical science with supervised patient experience, clinical reasoning and medical skills. The UCR options cover biomedical or behavioural aspects of health. Patient placements, medical skills training and preparation for clerkships remain specific to the Medicine programme.

audience.programmeDescription: Medicine at the University of Amsterdam studies disease and patient care through four recurring clinical themes. Students complete supervised placements, medical skills training and a bachelor’s thesis.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The closest UCR option focuses on biomedical disease mechanisms and research. The second brings together cognition, behaviour and social perspectives on health. Both share scientific topics with Medicine, while UvA trains students to assess and care for patients.
